article.title: Succession to moveable property in India in absence of proof of domicile elsewhere.
article.content:
19Succession to moveable property in India in absence of proof of domicile elsewhere.

Section 19  ·  Part II  ·  page 20 of the Act
If a person dies leaving moveable property in 1[India], in the absence of proof of any domicile elsewhere, succession to the property is regulated by the law of 1[India].
1 Subs. by Act 3 of 1951, s. 3 and Sch., for “the States”.
